topic: Filtering session duration for dwell time
summary_markdown:
The conversation focused on filtering criteria for calculating dwell time based on session duration. It was confirmed that the standard filter range for sessions is generally 0 < sd < 7200 seconds, specifically within `is_calibrated` sessions.

It was noted that the calculation of dwell time on the dashboard depends on whether the location is a mall and which algorithm (new or old) is used. For non-mall locations, the session filtering criteria remain consistent.

Finally, it was confirmed that zero-duration sessions are not included in the calculations.
decisions: The standard filter for dwell time calculation based on session duration is 0 < sd < 7200 seconds.
